suites.scope: Settings, focus, held selection and continuous real-time U/O zoom
Independent dual AI, difficulty/stat mapping, income decisions and recruitment

portableAcceptance.scope: Two isolated portable-EXE suites; personal installation/handoff checks are excluded.

features: Held U/O zoom continuously in real time, doubling/halving per second without OS-repeat startup delay; release stops immediately and simultaneous opposite keys cancel.
Each zoom update accepts at most 50 ms without catch-up. Battlefield-center anchoring, pointer-anchored wheel zoom, original 30 Hz logic and 350 ms/85 ms selection repeat remain unchanged.
Zoom remains available during combat pause. Editing fields and in-app confirmation retain keyboard priority; stale held inputs do not revive after interruption.
An explicit dual-AI mode independently selects four original strategies, deciding after income settlement; manual choices last until the next income round.
Each side can independently pause/start recruitment without freezing existing units, the opponent, game time or later AI decisions.

Selected difficulty stats are enabled by default. Disabling uses currently configured Normal stats for both sides, not a reset to original defaults. Original single-player and local-two-player modes remain.

sourceScan.scope: Public-source privacy scan coverage, not total Git repository disk usage.

privacy.scope: Frozen package runtime audit and public non-ZIP attachments; this later documentation receipt is not part of the frozen package.

limitations: 50x/100x and 240 FPS remain targets, not sustained-throughput guarantees; no new full-game Flash-parity claim.
The 203 public EXE checks are the arithmetic sum of 137 settings/smooth-zoom and 66 dual-AI checks, not unique scenarios or personal handoff checks.
The separate 34 private local handoff checks are not included in either public EXE suite. The local upgrade preserved settings and presets, not previous match progress.
Published package/notes/evidence retain frozen build-time status; this receipt adds publication evidence without repackaging.
All 40 remote asset sizes and GitHub API digests were checked; no complete remote ZIP redownload was performed.

localUpgradeSummary.privacy: Aggregate result only; personal values, file names, directories, process identifiers, raw reports and handoff screenshots are not published.
